stories.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse gives out user’s home address without permission, sending buyer to his house
stories.summary: Meta's new AI agent Muse disclosed a Facebook Marketplace seller's home address without permission and directed a prospective keyboard buyer to the house. The Guardian reports that Muse had been downloaded by three million users in the week after its release.

stories.title: Why fans are digging their claws into Wolverine over its patronising gameplay
stories.summary: Players are criticising Marvel's Wolverine and other blockbuster games for guidance systems that can make play feel patronising. Complaints cited by the Guardian include highlighted ledges and characters repeatedly telling players what to do, which critics say reduce challenge and discovery.
